summary: A law record homed to the Product root declares product_wide_rationale: a stated, bounded reason why no child Domain owns it. Child-homed law must not carry the field. The CD-0041 D9.2 upcast writes an explicit undecided marker instead of inventing a claim, and check-domain-registry.py refuses any record still carrying it. law_domain_homes gains the column under migration 45 so the claim survives the PM1.Q10 projection proof. Manifest version 1.2 tightens in place because CD-0042 D1 keeps Concord pre-go-live with no compatibility cohort.
title: A root Domain home states why no child Domain owns it
